QuestInfo.name: Sandwich for Breakfast
QuestInfo.0: You fed breakfast to #p1013102#. Come to think of it, you're hungry too... Go ask #b#p1013101##k about breakfast.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013101# gave you a sandwich for breakfast. He tells you to #bgo inside the house again once you're done with your sandwich#k. Mom must have something she wants to ask you to do... In any case, eat your sandwich first.
QuestInfo.2: Mom suddenly handed you a #t1003028#. Huh? Why did she give this to you?

npc.0: Aren't you going to eat your breakfast? Once you're done, go back #binto the house#k.

item.0: Oh, haven't you eaten your #bsandwich#k yet? You must be hungry, though. #bOpen your Item Inventory by pressing I, and then double-click on the items you wish to consume#k. Talk to me after #beating all of the sandwiches in your Item Inventory#k.
